immutable_ref_policy: A proof candidate is classified only at a full Git commit, with tree and source identities where locally or publicly available. Moving search-index commits and dated query responses are discovery evidence only.
credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only; no authenticated GitHub code-search credential was available.
network_policy: Read-only repository metadata and public-index queries only; no dependency clone, fetch, Lake update, Lake build, or .lake mutation.
search_order: repository-local Lean proof bodies and wrappers
manifest-pinned mathlib declarations and terminal source boundaries
official or primary Lean 4 formalization projects
other public Lean repositories at immutable revisions
historical Lean versions and other proof assistants as uncredited research evidence
aliases: 2n-1 integers contain n with sum divisible by n
surfaces: owned and repository-local Lean files via ripgrep
all manifest-materialized package Lean sources via ripgrep
mathlib Git history and pinned source tree
GitHub code search with explicit authentication or rate-limit failure handling
google-deepmind/formal-conjectures immutable tree when the public API is accessible
expected_negative_evidence: Each bounded public query records a dated result and response SHA-256 or an explicit access failure. No global-absence or discovery-saturation claim is permitted.
